item.name: Propane_Leak_Test_Solution
item.description: EASTMAN 65700B liquid gas leak detector, 2 oz, for LP-gas fittings.
item.readyBeforeUse: Enough solution is available for every connection being tested.
item.readyForNextPerson: The cap is closed and the bottle is stored upright.
item.ifNotReady: Ask the Propane Lead for replacement leak-test solution.

problem.condition: The applied solution forms growing bubbles.
problem.response: Close the fuel supply, keep the equipment out of service, and tell the Propane Lead. Never use a flame to test for a leak.
